strings.2009년, 매일 100km를 자전거로 출퇴근하던 그는 자기에게 필요한: In 2009, riding 100km to work and back every day, he began making the small parts he needed himself. When his GT-Roller, a roller that moves much like real riding, was well received, he left his job and incorporated the company in 2014. Planning, development, manufacturing and sales are still handled by a small team.

Instead of the shifter dictating the drivetrain, you choose the parts you love first and fit the lever to them.

strings.그렇다고 새로운 기술에 반대하는 것은 아닙니다. 에어로, 유압 디스크,: That does not mean opposing new technology. Aero, hydraulic discs and internal cables are good choices for those who need them. The point is to keep another clear path open, so riders who don't need them aren't forced to pay for them.

Its CEO, Masayuki Kimura, was an engineer designing production equipment and special-purpose robots at a major manufacturer, and a racer who rode track at national level as a student and finished the Tour of Japan with a club team.
strings.그로우택(GROWTAC)은 일본 도쿄의 자전거 부품 브랜드입니다. 유압에: GROWTAC is a bicycle parts brand from Tokyo, Japan. EQUAL mechanical disc brakes that rival hydraulics, Kashima Coat calipers and stepless Control Levers that work with any brand or speed, at Rubi Workshop in Seoul.

strings.기계식은 당김이 무겁고 제동력이 약하다는 인식을 바꾸는 것. 선택의 자유: Changing the idea that mechanical means a heavy pull and weak braking. Freedom of choice, with no compromise on performance, is the EQUAL principle.
In the days of downtube shifters, parts could be mixed freely. Today, compatibility rules set by manufacturers narrow the choices. GROWTAC calls changing this the democratization of the bicycle, aiming to give the choice back to riders and shops rather than manufacturers.
strings.단수가 하나 늘거나 규격이 바뀔 때마다, 멀쩡히 쓰던 부품까지 통째로 바: Every time a gear is added or a standard changes, perfectly good parts have to be replaced wholesale. EQUAL began with that frustration.

strings.레버비를 바꿔 제동의 성격을 체중과 취향에 맞춥니다. 컨트롤 위주로, 또: Change the leverage to match braking character to your weight and taste. Set it up for control, or for stronger initial bite.
strings.레진 기반 세라믹 세미메탈릭 컴파운드(EVO RESIN)에 알루미늄 백플: A resin-based ceramic semi-metallic compound (EVO RESIN) on aluminum backplates, for high braking power and durability. Shimano road-type pads also fit when it is time to replace them.
strings.로드 · MTB 디레일러, 내장기어 허브: Road and MTB derailleurs, internal gear hubs

The adapter you need depends on your frame and fork mounts and rotor size (140 / 160mm). If you are unsure, send us your bike details before ordering and Rubi Workshop will check.
The GROWTAC EQUAL range officially imported to Korea by Rubi Company.
strings.루비컴퍼니는 그로우택의 한국 공식 수입원입니다. 이퀄 브레이크와 컨트롤: Rubi Company is the official importer of GROWTAC in Korea. Bike shops interested in stocking EQUAL brakes and Control Levers, please contact Rubi Supply.
strings.매일 100km 출퇴근에 필요한 작은 부품을 직접 만들다, 롤러 GT-R: Making small parts for a 100km daily commute, then becoming known for the GT-Roller.
strings.무게와 장착 규격은 컬러 버전과 같고, 표면 처리와 피스톤 구조가 다릅니: Weight and mounting are the same as the color versions; the surface treatment and piston design differ.
strings.무단 방식이 낯설다면 옵션 클릭 플레이트로 익숙한 클릭감을 더합니다. 조: If stepless feels unfamiliar, the optional Click Plate adds a familiar click, while keeping the freedom to combine.

strings.무단 변속으로 단수와 제조사를 가리지 않는 드롭바 레버. 로드와 MTB: A drop bar lever whose stepless shifting works with any speed or brand. Road and MTB derailleurs alike.
strings.무단(프릭션) 변속으로 2~13단, 로드와 MTB 디레일러를 제조사 구분: A drop bar brake and shift lever whose stepless (friction) shifting runs 2–13 speed road and MTB derailleurs of any brand. Brake-only Shiftless model and optional Click Plate.

strings.부품을 고르는 기준은 라이더의 취향이어야 합니다. 이퀄은 제조사와 단수,: Parts should be chosen by the rider's taste. EQUAL is a line made so you never have to give up a part you love because of brands, speeds or standards.
strings.블루와 골드 컬러의 이퀄 브레이크 캘리퍼: EQUAL brake calipers in blue and gold
Flat mount shown. Post mount comes in the same colors.
strings.상급, 중급 같은 등급을 두지 않습니다. 레이스용, 투어링과 그래블용처럼: No top, middle or entry grades. Products are divided by purpose, such as racing or touring and gravel, and each is the flagship for its use.
strings.세계 최경량급 기계식 캘리퍼: Among the lightest mechanical calipers in the world
strings.스탠다드와 시프트리스는 좌우를 자유롭게 조합합니다. 1x 빌드라면 오른쪽: Standard and Shiftless can be combined freely left and right. For a 1x build, Standard on the right and Shiftless on the left. For a classic build that leaves shifting to bar-end shifters, Shiftless on both sides. The slim ergonomic hoods are easy to grip even for small hands, and reach adjustment fits the lever to your hand.
strings.액추에이터 암에서 레버비를 바꿔 제동의 성격을 조절합니다. 처음에는 약한: Change the leverage at the actuator arm to tune braking character. We recommend starting on the softer setting and increasing it to suit you. An indicator on the arm shows when the cable tension needs resetting.
strings.오일도, 블리딩 키트도, 호스 커팅도 필요 없습니다. 여행 중에 문제가: No oil, no bleed kit, no hose cutting. If something goes wrong on a trip, a cable is all you need to fix it, and the calipers are designed to be taken apart for service. A brake to trust under hard braking in road racing and cyclocross, and on long rides and bike travel.
Mechanical disc brakes that rival hydraulics. GROWTAC EQUAL, Tokyo, Japan.
strings.이퀄 기계식 디스크 브레이크는 캘리퍼 하나가 아니라 시스템 전체를 설계했: The EQUAL mechanical disc brake is designed as a whole system, not just a caliper. A dedicated hard outer housing that resists deformation carries the lever's force, a low-friction coated stainless inner cable keeps the pull light, and pads made with Vesrah turn that force into stopping power. That is why it is compared with hydraulic discs.
strings.이퀄 브레이크 액추에이터 암과 레버비 조정부: EQUAL brake actuator arm and leverage adjuster
strings.이퀄 브레이크는 프레임과 포크의 마운트 규격, 로터 크기, 레버 조합에: The adapters and cable lengths EQUAL brakes need depend on your frame and fork mounts, rotor size and levers. At Rubi Workshop we work out the setup for your bike and install it with a fresh cable run in the dedicated housing.

Its stepless (friction) action moves the cable exactly as far as you push the lever, with no clicks, so it runs any mechanical derailleur from 2 to 13 speed, free from brands, groupsets and speed counts.

EQUAL's hard housing reduces that deformation and carries the lever's force to the caliper. When installing, it is best to replace the old housing and run the full line with the included housing.

A mechanical disc brake pairing a super duralumin caliper with dedicated cables and pads. Flat and post mount.

strings.카시마 코트는 경질 아노다이징에 고체 윤활제인 이황화몰리브덴을 더한 표면: Kashima Coat is a surface treatment that combines hard anodizing with molybdenum disulfide, a solid lubricant. Hard and low in friction, it has long been used on MTB suspension parts that slide and take repeated contact. The EQUAL Kashima Coat version applies it not only to the caliper body but also to the piston and the parts around the pads.
strings.캘리퍼 바디와 피스톤, 패드 주변 부품에 카시마 코트를 적용한 이퀄 브레: An EQUAL brake with Kashima Coat on the caliper body, piston and parts around the pads. A greaseless piston keeps the braking feel consistent over long use.
strings.캘리퍼 바디와 피스톤에 카시마 코트를 입힌 이퀄 브레이크. 그리스 없이: An EQUAL brake with Kashima Coat on the caliper body and piston. A piston that slides without grease.
strings.캘리퍼로 들어가는 케이블 경로를 다듬어 마찰을 줄였습니다. 레버는 가볍게: The cable path into the caliper is refined to cut friction. A lighter lever, easier installation and a cleaner look.
Japanese bicycle parts that challenge hydraulics with a single cable.

strings.클릭 없이 마리오네트를 움직이듯 조작하는 그로우택만의 감각. 쓸수록 자전: A feel unique to GROWTAC, like working a marionette, with no clicks. The more you use it, the more at one with the bike you become.
strings.표면 경도가 높아 달리고 정비하는 동안 생기는 긁힘과 얼룩에 강하고, 오: Its high surface hardness resists the scratches and marks of riding and maintenance, keeping the caliper looking new for longer. Less wear on sliding surfaces also keeps the braking feel consistent over time. A specification that puts performance and durability ahead of colored anodizing.
strings.프레임에 장착한 이퀄 플랫마운트 브레이크: EQUAL flat mount brake on a frame
strings.플랫마운트와 포스트마운트 두 가지이며, 전 · 후 캘리퍼와 케이블 세트가: Available in flat and post mount, only as a full set with front and rear calipers and cable sets.
strings.피스톤 어셈블리의 미끄럼면에 카시마 코트를 입혀 그리스 없이도 부드럽게: Kashima Coat on the sliding surfaces of the piston assembly lets it move smoothly without grease. With less risk of grease or oil reaching the pads and rotor, braking power is protected from contamination.
strings.한쪽 레버에 시프트 레버를 최대 3개, 케이블을 2가닥까지. 필요 없는: Up to three shift levers and two cables per side. Remove the sub-levers you don't need and keep only what you use.
strings.회사를 나와 법인 그로우택을 세웁니다. 기획부터 판매까지 모두 직접 하는: He leaves his job and incorporates GROWTAC, a small maker that handles everything from planning to sales itself.
